name: Evomon Online
storyline:
The most powerful Evomon, Rhinoflame, Orx, and Eustone, have joined forces to take down a shared enemy: the almighty Redevil, keeper of the Ultragem.

Challenge friends in the Battle of the Ultragem. Create a team of five Evomon and confront your rivals. Discover the lore behind the monsters and the secrets of the war as you gather all the puzzle pieces to reach the final resolution.
summary:
Evomon Online lets you play Evomon without needing physical cards or local friends to challenge. New to Evomon? Don't worry! The game includes the rules and links to an official Discord server where you can learn the ropes and find opponents to battle.

Build your team of five Evomon and compete in epic battles of strategy and luck. Complete all achievements and unlock every reward!
